chain.why: Based on IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020 (TaxGuru copy), this means employer cover is a group policy and can only be migrated to your own name when you exit the group.
According to IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020 (TaxGuru copy), this means moving from group cover to your own policy may be subject to the insurer's underwriting.
Based on IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, paras 11–12, this means a fresh policy bought after leaving a job starts its waiting periods from zero.
According to MoSPI/NSO, NSS 80th round press note, 20 Apr 2026, this means the median cost of a private‑hospital stay is about ₹24,000, which can be a substantial out‑of‑pocket expense.

conclusion: Thus, relying on your employer’s group cover now may leave you without coverage, subject to underwriting and new waiting periods, exposing you to potentially high hospital costs if you wait to get a personal policy later.
